C37.content_en:
Ways to find keywords in the same genre — and how the main tools compare

In affiliate articles you also want to catch people who say the same thing another way. Enter one keyword and this tool lists up to 100 keywords in the same genre, with monthly volume and difficulty.

* You can choose 100, 300 or 1,000 rows (the default is 100). Where the text below says "100", it describes the default. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.024 per call for 100 rows (measured)Keywords in the same genre with volume and difficulty, 100 rows. Save as CSV
Google "people also search for" (by hand)FreeShown in results, without volume
Ahrefs Keywords Explorer (Keyword ideas)Subscription (see the official site for plans)A list of ideas with numbers
Google Keyword PlannerFree (needs a Google Ads account)Has a feature that suggests ideas from keywords (see the official site)

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Rephrasings turn up. Close words that do not contain yours appear (from "how to start a blog" came "how to get blog" and "blogger tutorial for beginners"; measured in the US).
  • The total is visible. About 174 thousand in total for "how to start a blog" (measured in the US).
  • About $0.024 for 100. About 40 per $1.
  • A few seconds. We measured under 2 seconds for the call.
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want only close words → topics far from yours also mix in. For "how to start a blog", some rows were off-topic, such as "how to make a twitter thread" (measured in the US).
  • You want a table with every difficulty filled in → DataForSEO says keyword difficulty needs SERP data, so it is only available for keywords in its SERP database. In our test ("how to start a blog"), 2 of the 30 rows in the saved sample were blank.
  • You want more than 100 → choose 300 or 1,000 in the count field.
  • Some rows can come back without a volume (none of the 30 saved sample rows did).

This tool does one thing: show up to 100 keywords in the same genre as your keyword, with volume and difficulty.

FAQ

Why do loosely related words appear?

We show what the API returns as the same genre, unfiltered.

Why are many difficulty values blank?

DataForSEO says keyword difficulty needs SERP data, so it is only available for keywords in its SERP database. In our test ("how to start a blog"), 2 of the 30 rows in the saved sample were blank.

What does a blank volume mean?

The API returned no value for that row. We leave it blank.

How is it different from "related keywords" and "phrases containing a keyword"?

Related keywords widen by following relations. Phrases that contain a keyword must contain your word. This one widens by genre grouping.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C38.content_en:
Ways to check keyword difficulty — and how the main tools compare

When you propose article topics to a client, you want to check which keywords are easier and which are hard, all at once. Enter keywords one per line and this tool returns a difficulty (0–100) per keyword as a table.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.012 for 3 keywords and $0.072 for 500 (measured). Above 1,000 it splits automatically (up to 5,000)Difficulty for several keywords in one table. Save as CSV
Ahrefs Keywords ExplorerSubscription (see the official site for plans)Its KD is a 0–100 estimate based on the backlinks of the top 10 results (per Ahrefs' help)
Semrush Keyword OverviewSubscription (see the official site for plans)Its KD% is a 0–100 score from evaluating the top 10 results (per Semrush's help)
UbersuggestSubscription and one-time options are advertised (prices differ by source; see the official site)See the official site for features

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Check many keywords together. Line up your proposed candidates and compare in one call.
  • Numbers as returned. No verdicts or colors.
  • About $0.012 for 3 keywords and $0.072 for 500 (measured). Up to 1,000 go in one request; more are split automatically (up to 5,000).
  • A few seconds. We measured under 1 second for the call.
  • Save as CSV. Paste it into a proposal.

When it is not the right fit

  • You expect the same number as another tool → each tool calculates difficulty its own way (Ahrefs' own article notes the same keyword can score very differently). Do not set numbers from different tools side by side.
  • A keyword has no difficulty → DataForSEO says keyword difficulty needs SERP data, so it is only available for keywords in its SERP database. The 3 words we entered all returned a value. Words that come back blank in one search can stay blank when you re-enter them.
  • You also want volume → this table shows difficulty only. "See search volume" fits for volume.
  • Difficulty is a guide. Whether you can reach the top also depends on your content, backlinks and more.

This tool does one thing: show the difficulty (0–100) of several keywords at once.

FAQ

What is the 0–100 number?

DataForSEO describes it as its own score for how hard it is to reach the top 10 results, with 0 easy and 100 extremely hard.

Is it the same as Ahrefs' difficulty?

Not necessarily. The calculations differ, so the same keyword can score differently.

How many keywords can I enter?

DataForSEO's spec says up to 1000. We confirmed up to 3 here.

Why do some keywords show nothing?

Words missing from DataForSEO's SERP data come back with a blank difficulty. We have not checked whether a blank row is still charged.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
